name: Camps Kenwood & Evergreen Rookie Week
description_short: A one-week overnight introduction to camp for rising 2nd and 3rd graders at Camps Kenwood (boys) and Evergreen (girls) in Wilmot, NH. Campers sample activities in every department. The program is limited to eight campers per side.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund if you cancel before January 1, 2027. A deposit is required at enrollment.

warnings: The only dates on the page are for summer 2026 (July 11–17, 2026), and that week has already passed. No 2027 Rookie Week dates or price are posted. Check the Dates & Rates page for 2027.
The $1,999 price is described as 'credited toward next summer'. This seems to mean it counts toward a later full session, but the page does not give the terms.
Grades are 'rising' grades, meaning the grade the child enters in the fall after camp. No ages are given.
unknowns: Age range (only rising grades 2–3 are stated)
Meals (presumably included for overnight camp, but not stated)

changes: Updated to 2027: Rookie Week is July 11-16, 2027 (Sunday drop-off, Friday pick-up), $1,999 credited toward next summer. The draft had the past 2026 week.
Fixed the group size: the camp now says eight campers per side, not seven.
Added the cancellation rule from the dates and rates page: full refund before January 1, 2027.
Removed the dash from the name.
open_questions: This listing is only Rookie Week, a one-week taster inside Camps Kenwood & Evergreen. The main camp (2027 Full Summer $17,399 June 26 to Aug 10, half sessions $11,299 each) has no draft or listing. Should we list the main camp instead, with Rookie Week as one of its sessions? Kenwood is for boys and Evergreen for girls on one site, so it may also need a call on one listing or two.
